draft_text: Thornbill-NER appears somewhat robust to label noise in its training annotations.
rationale: The package contains no label-noise experiments; all results (T1) are on original labels. The robustness criterion and noise-aware loss are described in methods but never tested. No evidence supports any claim about robustness to label noise.

judgement.proposition: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise in training annotations
judgement.strongest_supported: No evidence in the package evaluates label noise; the package only reports results on original labels, so no claim about robustness to label noise is supported.
